title: 第二十三章 有人闹事第二十四章 扔出去
lines: 天玄城是天玄王国的帝都，能成为其中的四大家族之一，王家之强足见一斑。
这么强大的家族，洪天学院院长都要卖几分情面，想找什么样的老师找不到，居然认一个师资考核为零分的家伙为师，简直就是羞辱！
莫大的羞辱！
他是学院的老生，这个张悬的事情，别人不知道，他知道的很清楚，曾经指导的学生走火入魔，丢尽老师脸面！
此人曾是他和别人茶余饭后的谈资，嘲笑的对象，做梦都没想到，自己的亲妹妹，居然拜了他为师！
如果这件事给其他同学知道了，岂不变成笑柄？
王涛越想越气，几步来到课堂门前，紧接着就看到了包裹和木乃伊一样的姚寒。
“原来是王涛少爷！”
姚寒身为白玉城管家，与不少势力打过交道，王涛身为天才，又是王家家主的公子，他早就见过。
“你是……”看了一眼，王涛眉毛一扬。
姚寒被打的太惨了，早已面目全非，连赵雅都很难辨认，更别说他了。
“在下白玉城姚寒！”姚寒道。
“哦，原来是姚大管家，你怎么……”王涛一愣。
“我练功不小心伤到的……”姚寒尴尬的解释了一句，立刻转移话题：“不知王涛少爷来这里干什么？”
“我妹妹居然认这个张悬为师，我现在就把她抓回去，然后出手好好教训一顿这个不知天高地厚的老师！”王涛毫不掩饰自己的愤怒。
“啊？你妹妹？你说的是王颖小姐？”
姚寒刚才进入房间，就被撵了出来，而且注意力都集中在张悬身上，并没看到王颖也在其中。
王涛点头。
“我听说王颖小姐的天赋，比起你都丝毫不差，为何会选择他？”姚寒满是奇怪。
“我妹妹从未出过门，一向单纯，这家伙巧舌如簧，不知胡言乱语了什么，我妹妹居然就相信了！”想起刘老跟他说的事，王涛就气不打一处来。
“可恶！这家伙简直就是个祸害，老师的败类！”姚寒想起自家小姐，也被对方欺骗，愤怒的咬牙：“王涛少爷，你必须好好教训一下这家伙！”
“嗯！”王涛应了一声，同时疑惑的看过来：“对了，姚管家，你怎么也在这里？”
“不说了，越说越气，我们家小姐，也被这个张悬不知用什么言语欺骗，拜他为师！”姚寒哼道。
“你说的是赵雅小姐？”王涛一愣。
“是啊！”姚寒点头。
“那……你为什么不进去拆穿这个虚伪的家伙，反而在门口等着？”王涛奇怪。
“我要拆穿这家伙，结果我们家小姐跟我着急，我也没办法，只好现在外面等着，王涛少爷你来了正好，刚好进去教训一下那个无耻的家伙，当众拆穿他丑恶的嘴脸，也让我们家小姐看清他的真面目！”
姚寒道。
“放心吧，我这就去拆穿他，让这个无耻的家伙，露出丑陋的嘴脸！”
王涛牙齿咬紧，点点头，一脚将门踹开，大步走了进去。
另外一边，张悬终于把五个学员的情况都说了一遍。
郑阳的枪法有些缺点，张悬细说了一下，让前者顿时大喜过望，力量再次暴增。
至于袁涛，他没修炼过系统的功法和武技，张悬拿出学院最基础的洪天九重诀第一重，稍微修改了一些缺点，递了过去。
虽然没修改多少，和他修炼到天道功法有很大差距，却比原本洪天九重诀高级了好多倍，袁涛只看了一眼，就兴奋地差点跳起来，高兴地知道，遇到了名师。
“好了，你们身上的问题，我基本都单独讲了一遍，修炼需要坚持不懈……”
content_en:
Tianxuan City is the imperial capital of Tianxuan Kingdom, and to be one of the four major families in it shows how strong the Wang family is.
For such a powerful family, the dean of Hongtian College has to show some kindness. He can't find any kind of teacher he wants. He actually accepts a guy with a zero score in the teacher evaluation as his teacher. It's simply humiliating!
What a shame!
He is an old student of the college. Others don't know about Zhang Xuan. He knows very well that the students he once guided went crazy and disgraced the teacher!
This person had been the subject of discussion and ridicule between him and others after dinner. He never dreamed that his own sister would actually become his teacher!
If other students found out about this, wouldn't it become a laughing stock?
The more Wang Tao thought about it, the angrier he became. He took a few steps to the door of the classroom and saw Yao Han wrapped like a mummy.
"It turns out to be Master Wang Tao!"
As the steward of White Jade City, Yao Han had dealt with many forces. As a genius and the son of the head of the Wang family, Wang Tao had already met him.
"You are..." After taking a look, Wang Tao raised his eyebrows.
Yao Han was beaten so badly that he was completely unrecognizable. It was difficult for even Zhao Ya to recognize him, let alone him.
"I'm here with Yao Han in White Jade City!" Yao Han said.
"Oh, it turns out to be Butler Yao, why did you..." Wang Tao was stunned.
"I accidentally injured myself while practicing..." Yao Han explained awkwardly and immediately changed the subject: "I wonder what Young Master Wang Tao is doing here?"
"My sister actually recognizes this Zhang Xuan as her teacher. I will take her back now and teach this ignorant teacher a lesson!" Wang Tao did not hide his anger.
"Ah? Your sister? Are you talking about Miss Wang Ying?"
Yao Han entered the room just now and was kicked out. His attention was focused on Zhang Xuan and he did not see Wang Ying among them.
Wang Tao nodded.
"I heard that Miss Wang Ying's talent is no worse than yours. Why would you choose him?" Yao Han was very surprised.
"My sister has never been out and has always been simple. This guy is so eloquent that he talks nonsense, but my sister actually believes it!" Wang Tao became very angry when he thought of what Mr. Liu told him.
"Damn it! This guy is simply a scourge, the teacher's scum!" Yao Han thought of his own lady, who was also deceived by the other party, and gritted his teeth angrily: "Master Wang Tao, you must teach this guy a lesson!"
"Yeah!" Wang Tao responded, and at the same time looked over with confusion: "By the way, Butler Yao, why are you here?"
"Stop talking. The more you talk, the angrier you get. Our young lady was also deceived by Zhang Xuan's unknown words and became a disciple of him!" Yao Han snorted.
"Are you talking about Miss Zhao Ya?" Wang Tao was stunned.
"Yes!" Yao Han nodded.
"Then... why didn't you go in and expose this hypocritical guy, instead of waiting at the door?" Wang Tao was surprised.
"I want to expose this guy, but our lady is worried about me, so I have no choice but to wait outside now. Master Wang Tao, you are here just in time. You can go in and teach that shameless guy a lesson, expose his ugly face in public, and let our lady see his true face!"
Yao Han said.
"Don't worry, I'm going to expose him right now and let this shameless guy show his ugly face!"
Wang Tao gritted his teeth, nodded, kicked the door open, and strode in.
…………………………
On the other side, Zhang Xuan finally explained the situation of the five students.
Zheng Yang's marksmanship had some shortcomings. Zhang Xuan explained it in detail, which made the former overjoyed and his strength increased sharply again.
As for Yuan Tao, he had never practiced any systematic exercises or martial arts. Zhang Xuan took out the first level of Hong Tian Jiu Jue, the most basic technique in the academy, slightly modified some shortcomings, and handed it over.
Although there were not many modifications, there was a big gap between the Heavenly Dao Kung Fu he had cultivated, but it was many times more advanced than the original Hongtian Nine-layer Technique. Yuan Tao only took one look at it and almost jumped up with excitement. He was happy to know that he had met a famous master.
"Okay, I've basically talked about your problems alone. Cultivation requires perseverance..."
